$comment: Realms product sheet for `realms seed` → `casals sheet deploy` on the GaaS Casals conductor. One fleet file_registry backend per network: put it on this sheet and adopt by name (register_canister then deploy_sheet) — never mint a second registry. marketplace_frontend is DNS adopt-only (*.realmsgos.org). No per-stand batons: those belong on realm stands (installer) and infra-baton (GaaS sheet). Catalog bytes, npm builds, and DNS stay in realms seed / env deploy. Demo realm stands (Agora, Dominion, Syntropia) live in casals-config/sheets/realms.json, not here.
